name: Sipsmith Sloe Gin
base_ingredient: Sipsmith London Dry Gin with sloe berries
production: London Dry Gin distilled on copper stills
Autumn-picked sloes frozen then rested in the gin
Real fruit, not juice; character varies by harvest
history: 2009 | Sipsmith founded in a workshop in Hammersmith, London
serve_official: Sloe gin & bitter lemon (ideal serve); or citrus/lemon tonic with an orange wheel; Sloe Royale
notes: Founded by childhood friends Fairfax and Sam (first names only per Gin Guild); master distiller Jared Brown. Sipsmith described as the first copper distillery in London for nearly 200 years.
